name: vLLM
description: High-throughput inference and serving engine for LLMs.
summary: AI-assisted contributions to vLLM are allowed, but a human must understand, review and be able to defend every changed line, purely agent-generated pull requests are banned, and AI-assisted PRs must state that AI was used. Trivial busywork PRs are rejected, and the guidelines say nothing specific about AI-written issues or discussion comments.

evidence.quote: These instructions apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `vllm-project/vllm`. Breaching these guidelines can result in automatic banning.
Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
The submitting human must review every changed line and run relevant tests.
Clear statement that AI assistance was used.
Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (single typo, isolated style change, one mutable default, etc.). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work.
If work is duplicate/trivial busywork, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.
PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
Why this is not duplicating an existing PR.
Model evaluation results when the change affects output, accuracy, or serving.
Clear statement that AI assistance was used.
Before opening a PR (drafts included) or requesting re-review, run the [`pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill and address its findings.
